page.layout: One blank leaf, a single page of the scan with no printed text. Handwritten marks only: a faded manuscript inscription at the top left, a manuscript numeral/tally mark in the lower right, and an old ink stain or shelf-type marks at the left edge.
page.notes: The page is blank: no printed text, no page number, no running head, no catchword and no signature. The handwriting at top left (a faded word, apparently a name or ownership note, with a numeral beneath it) and the ink tally marks at lower right are manuscript annotations, not printed text, and are therefore omitted. Dark scan borders and the binding edge at left and right are likewise omitted.
